kpis_story.description_fr: Octobre 2023 export controls US Chine ont impacté ~$80-100M revenue ENTG. Mitigation via expansion Asia (Korea, Taiwan, Japon), exit JV Chine 2024. Diversification accélérée.
kpis_story.description_en: October 2023 US China export controls impacted ~$80-100M ENTG revenue. Mitigation via Asia expansion (Korea, Taiwan, Japan), 2024 China JV exit. Accelerated diversification.

_notes: Semis materials pure-play. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
